label: Land water storage
long_name: Annual mean terrestrial water storage anomaly (liquid water equivalent)
source: NASA JPL GRACE and GRACE-FO mascons RL06.3 v04, 0.5° (land only)
citation: Watkins, M. M. et al. (2015). Improved methods for observing Earth's time variable mass distribution with GRACE using spherical cap mascons. JGR Solid Earth. doi:10.5067/TEMSC-3JC63
method: Mann-Kendall with bias-corrected AR(1) variance correction (Yue & Wang 2004; quadratic detrending), Theil-Sen slope, Benjamini-Hochberg FDR
